Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Fractional Reserve banking is effective as long as two things remain true. What are those two things, and why does fractional reserve banking depend on them?assistant
response:
The two things that remain true for fractional reserve banking to be effective are that the bank has sufficient reserves to cover withdrawals and that the loans made by the bank are properly collateralized. 

The first thing is that the bank has sufficient reserves to cover withdrawals, which means that the bank must maintain a certain percentage of its deposits in reserve, rather than lending them out. This ensures that the bank can meet its withdrawal obligations and avoid a bank run.

The second thing is that the loans made by the bank are properly collateralized, which means that the bank has a sufficient amount of assets to back up the loans it makes. This helps to reduce the risk of default and ensures that the bank can recover its losses if borrowers default on their loans.

These two things are crucial for fractional reserve banking to be effective because they help to maintain the stability of the financial system.
